candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory calls timing out (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, propagating ReadTimeout through inventory and order to gateway /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics or logs admitted; whether the timeout stems from redis saturation, network, or config is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (~2s) in inventory cascading as ReadTimeout to order and 502 at gateway checkout; metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2406ms) and 502s. Topology confirms inventory->redis path. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
